purpose: Tiny counterbalanced entity-recall diagnostic, not evidence of general coherence.
scoring: At the final prompt position compare raw next-character logits for the first character of the two choices; predict the larger, count exact ties as 0.5. No sampling or generated rationale. Both candidate first characters must exist in vocabulary; otherwise mark probe unscorable. Long receives full prompt, short last64 characters. Candidate names all have distinct first characters.
aggregation: Report all8 decisions, mean accuracy, and all4 within-pair both-correct counts. No significance claim from8 probes.
